data.turoyo: Ḥzele i kefo, d məlle aʕla u ǧənni, maḥatle, amṭele qayso d baluṭo hawxa qawyo, txəsle taḥt i kefayo w maqarsole, maqalbole.
data.translation: Da sah er den Stein, von dem der Geistermann gesprochen hatte, holte einen starken Eichenstamm herbei, schob ihn unter den Stein, stemmte ihn hoch und drehte ihn um.

rationale: Thin III Preterit cell; explicit lever, stone and lifting sequence.

summary: I koqərsile (116/30) and III komaqərsile (94/18) share levering-out meaning; III maqarsole (115/95) supplies a concrete lifting action with an oak trunk used as a lever. The context supports qrs, not qrṣ pinching.
115/95 has an expressed stone and following object suffix -o. 94/18 has an anaphoric slab object -le. The following result predicates describe removal or turning; they do not establish a new sense.
The 94/18 and 116/30 quotations already exist, so only the new 115/95 example is added. The three occurrences do not establish a semantic distinction between I and III or a new Detransitive.
Is there a systematic semantic or dialectal distinction between I and III levering? These occurrences show overlapping uses and do not resolve it.
